calls.title: Demo Call with Kasady Conder from Bucked Up
calls.summary: The meeting aimed at discussing the management and optimization of multiple marketing funnel offers at Bucked Up, particularly focusing on advanced split testing and data integration. Ethan Allred, the Marketing Funnels Manager, highlighted the challenges with the current Webflow Optimize tool, which is costly and struggles with accurate cross-domain event tracking. The team is exploring GrowthBook, which supports multi-arm bandit testing and offers better integration with data warehouses like Snowflake and Rudderstack. Additionally, they seek to improve experimentation strategies while reducing the annual spend on testing tools, currently around $90,000. Collaboratively, the group is planning to ensure existing testing workflows are preserved while enhancing data quality and overall cost efficiency.
calls.keywords: split testing, multi-armed bandit, conversion tracking, data warehouse, funnel domains, GA4 integration
